subject.title: fix(mcp): standalone apps stop hanging on stalled gateway requests

question: Should a session-owned MCP catalog refresh continue after its final App-operation waiter detaches, so it can warm the shared cache, or should the runtime abort it once no operation still needs the result?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically plausible, but they differ in transport/resource lifetime and cache-warming semantics; the repository needs an owner decision rather than a mechanical reviewer choice.

options.title: Keep runtime-owned refreshes
options.body: Preserve the branch behavior: detached callers stop waiting, while the current catalog generation may complete and populate the shared cache.

options.title: Abort without waiters
options.body: Cancel the active catalog generation when its final operation waiter detaches, trading cache warming for bounded background work.

recommendation.title: Keep runtime-owned refreshes
recommendation.body: Preserve the branch behavior: detached callers stop waiting, while the current catalog generation may complete and populate the shared cache.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the ownership contract implemented by the session MCP runtime and should be made by its current-main owner.
